columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Streaming safety exceptions must retain precedence when execution limits fail concurrently
columns.title_zh: 流式安全异常在执行上限同时失败时必须保持优先级
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260824-005 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The change preserves an already-triggered input-guardrail exception when the same streaming run also exceeds max turns, exposing a precise precedence rule for safety evidence versus execution-limit failure. This is a bounded Digital Employee control-state problem with deterministic regression coverage.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260824-005，Skill 02 评分 46/50。该变更在同一 Streaming Run 同时超过 Max Turns 时，仍保留已经触发的 Input Guardrail 异常，暴露出安全证据与执行上限失败之间明确的优先级规则。这是一个边界清晰、具有确定性回归测试的数字员工控制状态问题。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the RunResultStreaming state transitions, where the max-turn path is marked handled, when the guardrail exception is captured, the later error-check ordering, simultaneous-failure behavior and deterministic regression test. Do not generalize this demonstrated precedence rule to all exception arbitration.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 RunResultStreaming 状态转换、Max-Turn 路径在何处被标记为已处理、Guardrail 异常何时被捕获、后续 Error Check 的顺序、并发失败行为及确定性回归测试；不得把该已证明的优先级规则泛化为所有异常仲裁。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Subagent forks need explicit provenance boundaries for child-only developer instructions
columns.title_zh: 子 Agent Fork 需要为仅子级 Developer Instruction 建立显式来源边界
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260824-002 with Skill 02 score 46/50. A dedicated contextual fragment keeps child-only developer instructions classified as developer instructions across full-history subagent forks, delivers them to the child exactly once and excludes them from the parent request. This exposes a concrete architecture boundary for instruction provenance across agent lineage.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260824-002，Skill 02 评分 46/50。专用 Contextual Fragment 让仅属于子 Agent 的 Developer Instructions 在 Full-History Subagent Fork 中继续保持 Developer Instruction 来源分类，恰好一次进入子 Agent，并从父请求中排除。这提供了 Agent 血缘转换中 Instruction Provenance 的明确架构边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the contextual-fragment type, provenance classification, parent exclusion, exactly-once child injection, full-history fork behavior and regression tests. Do not equate instruction provenance with authorization or trust.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Contextual Fragment 类型、来源分类、父请求排除、子 Agent 恰好一次注入、Full-History Fork 行为及回归测试；不得把 Instruction Provenance 等同于授权或信任。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Cancellation-safe owners must finish idempotent sandbox cleanup before rethrowing cancellation
columns.title_zh: Cancellation-Safe Owner 必须在重新抛出取消前完成幂等 Sandbox 清理
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260824-004 with Skill 02 score 44/50. The sandbox dependency owner captures cancellation from one owned result, continues closing the remaining owned results exactly once, clears internal state and only then re-raises the first cancellation. The mechanism gives a narrow, testable lifecycle-ownership and idempotent-cleanup rule for agent infrastructure.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260824-004，Skill 02 评分 44/50。Sandbox Dependency Owner 捕获某个 Owned Result 的 Cancellation 后，会继续恰好一次关闭其余 Owned Results，清理内部状态，最后才重新抛出第一次 Cancellation。该机制为 Agent 基础设施提供了范围明确、可测试的生命周期所有权与幂等清理规则。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify ownership state, cancellation capture, remaining-cleanup ordering, exactly-once behavior across repeated close calls, cleanup-failure propagation and the boundary to owned sandbox dependencies. Do not infer distributed exactly-once semantics from this in-process cleanup contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验所有权状态、Cancellation 捕获、剩余清理顺序、重复 Close 下的 Exactly-Once 行为、Cleanup Failure 传播，以及规则仅适用于 Owned Sandbox Dependency 的边界；不得由进程内清理合同推断分布式 Exactly-Once 语义。
